summary: Denison Mines Corp. filed a routine Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, carrying its interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with CEO/CFO interim-filing certifications and a November 4, 2026 press release (US equivalent: quarterly report on Form 10-Q). No transaction is announced. Disclosed items include cash of C$362.7 million, convertible notes of C$583.0 million, 905.4 million shares outstanding and property, plant and equipment of C$504.6 million. Watch quarterly project spending and the convertible-note/capped-call overhang rather than arbitrage.
